name: Like-Dislike and Ratings Posts/Products
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
Like-Dislike and Ratings Posts/Products is a lightweight and easy-to-use plugin that lets users give instant feedback with like, dislike, and star rating options on posts or WooCommerce products.

Designed to improve user engagement, this plugin works seamlessly with any theme, loads via AJAX (no page reload), and offers full customization for placement, design, and behavior.

🎯 Features Overview

👍 Like / 👎 Dislike Buttons

  • Allow users to like or dislike posts and products.
  • Interactive buttons powered by AJAX.

⭐ Star Ratings System

  • Enable 1–5 star voting.
  • Show average rating for transparency.

🔁 Real-Time Feedback

  • Instantly display like/dislike counts and average rating.
  • Users and visitors can quickly judge the content.

🛡️ Anti-Spam Control

  • Block repeated votes via user login, IP, or cookie.
  • Guest voting supported.

🎨 Fully Customizable

  • Choose where to show buttons (before/after content).
  • Style buttons to match your design.
  • Works out of the box with most themes and WooCommerce.

⚙️ Developer Friendly

  • Lightweight and clean code with hooks/filters for extension.
sections.installation:
1. From your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Like-Dislike and Ratings Posts/Products.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Configure the plugin under Settings > Like Dislike Posts/Products.
sections.faq:
❓ Can guests vote?

Yes. You can allow guest users to like, dislike, or rate. Their votes are tracked using IP or cookies.

❓ Is it WooCommerce compatible?

Yes, it works perfectly on shop, product, and archive pages.

❓ Can I customize icons and position?

Yes. You can choose icon types and decide whether to place them before, after, or both.

❓ Does it use AJAX?

Yes. All voting actions are handled via AJAX without refreshing the page.

❓ Is it responsive?

Absolutely. The plugin is mobile-friendly and fully responsive.
